meta.title: HAZOP and LOPA of the H-100 unit
meta.scope: From TK-101 and the feed pumps P-100A/B through E-100, the FV-010 feed control and the H-100 coil to the outlet line to V-200; the fuel-oil train V-121 → FV-300 → burner; combustion air F-100 → FV-200; firebox, convection section, stack and damper HV-400; the BMS (SIS-100) and the start-up and shutdown procedures.
meta.objective: Identify the hazards and operability problems of the unit, judge their risk, and decide what must be added or changed. For the scenarios that need more than the existing safeguards, check the risk reduction by LOPA.
meta.assump: The heater is operated by trained staff at the design point (feed 6.8 L/s, 180 → 350 °C, fuel oil 243 kg/h, air 3892 kg/h). Instrument air, power and heating fluid from Unit A are available at start-up. Trips, the BMS and PSV-101 are proof-tested on the maintenance plan.
meta.protocol: Method: HAZOP to IEC 61882 with full recording. The team takes one node at a time, states its design intent, and applies the guide words to each parameter to find deviations. For each deviation it records the causes, the events that follow, the consequences without credit for safeguards, the existing safeguards, and the risk after safeguards (S × L). Rows above the tolerable level go to LOPA in the same worksheet: initiating-event frequency, enabling conditions and conditional modifiers, independent protection layers with their PFD, and the mitigated frequency compared with the tolerable event likelihood for the severity. Open points go to the Parking Lot; actions become recommendations with an owner and a due date.

tank drained

recs.text: Auto-start spare P-100B on low discharge pressure (PI-002) or P-100A trip, with the start completing inside the FSLL-008 delay; test the spare monthly.
Add level transmitter LT-101 on TK-101 with low-level alarm LAL and low-low pump trip LSLL to protect P-100A/B from running dry.
Provide minimum-flow recirculation (restriction orifice back to TK-101) on P-100A/B so a closed FV-010 cannot deadhead the running pump.
Confirm a check valve on each pump discharge; include in the inspection plan (passing check valve spins the idle pump backwards).
Implement cross-limiting (lead–lag) air/fuel control: fuel demand limited by measured air, air demand not below that needed for measured fuel.
Confirm coil design pressure ≥ pump shut-off head; otherwise add overpressure protection. Add high-pressure alarm on PI-005 (blocked outlet to V-200).
Water-draw and sampling procedure for the fuel-oil tank; alarm on water in fuel if available.
Written response procedure for high CO (AI-026) and low O₂ (AI-028): raise air first, then cut fuel; train on the simulator.
Start-up and shutdown procedures reviewed against this HAZOP; operators qualified on the simulator before first light-off.
